title: Astronauts told to return to ISS after sheltering over air leak repairs
summary: Astronauts aboard the International Space Station were instructed to return to the station after initially sheltering in place due to air leak repairs being conducted. This news event highlights ongoing maintenance challenges in space habitation and the careful coordination required for emergency response protocols in orbit.
problem_solved: Reports on the resolution of an air leak emergency situation on the International Space Station requiring astronaut shelter protocols.
why_valuable: Provides real-time coverage of space station operations and astronaut safety procedures during spacecraft emergencies.
